name: Kuge Honten
about: Kuge Honten is a brewery in Usuki, Oita. Its business dates from 1860, when the lord of the Inaba domain gave the family a brewing house. The main sake, Ichinoide, took its name in 1919 from the local place name.

It also makes barley shochu, including the Tsunezo series, and a plum liqueur blended with Usuki kabosu juice, first sold in 2007. Since the 2021 brewing year it says all its ingredients come from Oita, much of them from Usuki itself.
